name: tooneru
description: Read Japanese vertical-scroll manga about work and everyday life on トゥーンエル (tooneru.com): search works, read episodes and summaries, and look up glossary terms with sources. Read-only, no sign-in.

interface.longDescription:
トゥーンエル (toonERU, https://tooneru.com/) is a Japanese vertical-scroll manga media site. Its stories are set in real workplaces and everyday life. This plugin lets ChatGPT read the published works with six read-only tools:

- search_works: find works and episodes by keyword or genre, including the job, tax, money and procedure terms the stories cover (for example 配車 "taxi dispatch" or 無申告加算税 "penalty tax for unfiled returns")
- list_episodes: a work's description and its published episodes
- get_episode: an episode's full text (dialogue with speakers, narration, scene descriptions, and what the episode explains)
- get_context: a short summary of an episode's setting, characters, synopsis, terms and sources
- list_new_episodes: recently published episodes
- get_glossary: a work's glossary (short explanations, whether each entry is a rule of the story's world or a real-world fact, and sources)

Who it is for: readers who want to find a story, recap what they have read, or talk about what may happen next without spoilers, and people who want to learn work and life terms through stories.

Limitations: The works are in Japanese. Every tool only reads published works: there is no writing, no sign-in, and no personal information is requested. Tool inputs (search words, work IDs, episode numbers) are used only to return results and are not stored in a database. If you give the number of the episode you have read, synopses and terms from later episodes are left out. Glossary entries are general explanations, not individual legal, tax or financial advice. Some stories feature real companies' services; each such episode says so. Each result includes the work title and the episode URL for citation.

Developer guide: https://tooneru.com/developers/
Operated by H株式会社 (H inc.).
capabilities: Look up glossary terms with sources
defaultPrompt: トゥーンエルの新しい話を5つ教えて。
トゥーンエルで、配車が出てくる作品を探して。
トゥーンエルに、無申告加算税が出てくる漫画はある？

positive.description: Find works by a job term. (Prompt: "Find works on トゥーンエル that involve taxi dispatch.")
positive.prompt: トゥーンエルで、配車が出てくる作品を探して。
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_works with query 配車 and lists the matching works (including 空車の王都, id taxi) with titles and work URLs on tooneru.com.

positive.description: List new episodes. (Prompt: "Show me five new episodes on トゥーンエル.")
positive.prompt: トゥーンエルの新しい話を5つ教えて。
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_new_episodes with limit 5 and lists five episodes, newest first, with work title, episode title, publication date and episode URL.

positive.description: Synopsis and terms of one episode. (Prompt: "Give me the synopsis and terms of episode 1 of 車屋に、車さんが来た。 on トゥーンエル.")
positive.prompt: トゥーンエルの「車屋に、車さんが来た。」の第1話のあらすじと、出てくる用語を教えて。
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the work with search_works, reads episode 1 with get_context (or get_episode) and the glossary with get_glossary, then gives a short synopsis of episode 1 and its terms, citing the episode URL.

positive.description: Find a work by a tax term and explain the term with sources. (Prompt: "Is there a manga on トゥーンエル about the penalty tax for unfiled returns? Explain the term with sources.")
positive.prompt: トゥーンエルに、無申告加算税が出てくる漫画はある？その言葉の解説を出典つきで教えて。
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the work with search_works (query 無申告加算税), reads its glossary with get_glossary, and explains the term as a general explanation with the source URL from the glossary and the work or episode URL. It does not give individual tax advice.

positive.description: Spoiler-free recap after episode 1. (Prompt: "I have read episode 1 of 空車の王都 on トゥーンエル. Summarize the characters and setting so far without spoilers.")
positive.prompt: トゥーンエルの「空車の王都」を第1話まで読んだ。ネタバレなしで、ここまでの登場人物と設定を整理して。
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the work, calls get_context (or get_episode) for episode 1 with up_to_episode=1, and summarizes the characters and setting up to episode 1 only, without events from episode 2 or later.

negative.description: Unrelated request: weather. The plugin only reads トゥーンエル works, so it should not be called; ChatGPT answers with its own tools. (Prompt: "Tell me tomorrow's weather in Tokyo.")
negative.prompt: 明日の東京の天気を教えて。

negative.description: Unrelated request: programming. No トゥーンエル tool should be called. (Prompt: "How do I reverse a list in Python?")
negative.prompt: Python でリストを逆順にする書き方を教えて。

negative.description: Unrelated request: rewriting a business email. No トゥーンエル tool should be called. (Prompt: "Rewrite 'I will be absent from tomorrow's meeting' as a polite email to a client.")
negative.prompt: 「明日の会議は欠席します」を、取引先に送る丁寧なメールの文に直して。

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads published manga works.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: six read-only tools to search トゥーンエル works, read episodes and context summaries, list new episodes, and look up glossary terms with sources.

ja-JP.subtitle: マンガで得る！縦読み漫画メディア
ja-JP.description:
マンガで得る！仕事と暮らしの現場を描く縦読み漫画メディア「トゥーンエル」。（https://tooneru.com/）

このプラグインをつなぐと、ChatGPT が次の6つの道具で、公開中の作品を読めます。
・search_works：言葉やジャンルで作品と話を探す（仕事・制度・お金・手続きの言葉からも探せます）
・list_episodes：作品の説明と、公開中の話の一覧
・get_episode：話の本文（話者付きの台詞・ナレーション・絵の説明・この話で分かること）
・get_context：話の設定・登場人物・あらすじ・用語・出典の短いまとめ
・list_new_episodes：新しく公開された話
・get_glossary：作品の用語集（短い解説・作中の世界の決まりか現実の事実かの区別・出典）

仕事と暮らしの現場が漫画でわかります。転職、就活、副業、職場の AI、確定申告、年金、介護、離婚の話を読めます。作中の言葉には出典つきの解説が付きます。企業のサービスが実名で登場する作品もあります。

どの道具も読むだけで、書き込み・ログインはなく、利用者の個人の情報を求めません。道具の入力（探す言葉・作品の id・話の番号）は答えを返すためだけに使い、データベースには保存しません。読んだ話の番号を渡すと、それより後の話のあらすじと用語を省いて返します。作中の世界の決まりは物語の設定で、現実の事実とは分けて返します。用語の解説は一般的な説明で、個別の法律・税・お金の相談の代わりにはなりません。各話の結果には作品名と話の URL が入っていて、出典に使えます。

使い方の案内：https://tooneru.com/developers/
運営：H株式会社
